vulnerabilities.title: Hardcoded default password for demo user
vulnerabilities.description: The original code sets a hardcoded default password (ChangeThisPassword!123) for the demo user 'alice' when ALICE_PASSWORD/USERS_JSON are not provided.
vulnerabilities.impact: Attackers can authenticate with a known credential if the environment is misconfigured, leading to account compromise.

fix.description: Remove the hardcoded default and generate an ephemeral strong password when no credentials are provided, prompting operators to supply deterministic credentials via environment variables.
fix.secure_code_snippet:
default_pwd = os.environ.get("ALICE_PASSWORD")
if default_pwd is None:
    default_pwd = secrets.token_urlsafe(16)
    app.logger.warning("ALICE_PASSWORD not set; generated ephemeral password for alice. Set USERS_JSON or ALICE_PASSWORD to provide deterministic credentials.")

vulnerabilities.title: Missing CSRF protection on state-changing endpoints
vulnerabilities.description: POST endpoints (/upload_profile, /run, /login) lacked CSRF protection, allowing cross-site request forgery if authenticated sessions are used.
vulnerabilities.impact: An attacker could coerce a victim's browser to perform authenticated actions without their consent.

fix.description: Introduce a @before_request hook that enforces CSRF tokens (header/form/json) or validates Origin/Referer against trusted origins for unsafe HTTP methods.

vulnerabilities.title: Missing security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.)
vulnerabilities.description: The application did not set common defensive HTTP headers to mitigate clickjacking, MIME sniffing, and basic XSS vectors.
vulnerabilities.impact: Browsers may render content in less secure ways, increasing exposure to UI redress and injection risks.

fix.description: Add an @after_request hook to set X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, and Content-Security-Policy, and apply HSTS when served over HTTPS.

hardcoded_secrets.note: Removed in the fixed version; replaced with a generated ephemeral password when no credentials are provided.
